knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: UPDATE VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_01 SET org_lvl_cd = CASE WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 3 THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 6 THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) IN (7, 9, 12) THEN '3' ELSE org_lvl_cd END, org_lvl_cd = CASE WHEN org_no IN ('260', '270', '280') THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 6 AND SUBSTR(org_no, 4, 1) = '9' THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 7 AND SUBSTR(org_no, 5, 1) = '9' THEN '3' ELSE org_lvl_cd END
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: UPDATE VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_01 SET org_lvl_cd = CASE WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 3 THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 6 THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) IN (7, 9, 12) THEN '3' ELSE org_lvl_cd END, org_lvl_cd = CASE WHEN org_no IN ('260', '270', '280') THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 6 AND SUBSTR(org_no, 4, 1) = '9' THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 7 AND SUBSTR(org_no, 5, 1) = '9' THEN '3' ELSE org_lvl_cd END
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 机构信息-根据机构号长度计算机构层级（总行1级/分行2级/支行3级）
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 在临时表上执行UPDATE，基于机构号长度推导机构层级
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 机构号长度、机构号前缀

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT org_no, CASE WHEN org_no IN ('260','270','280') THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no)=3 THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no)=6 AND SUBSTR(org_no,4,1)='9' THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no)=6 THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no)=7 AND SUBSTR(org_no,5,1)='9' THEN '3' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) IN (7,9,12) THEN '3' END AS org_lvl_cd FROM O_CRMS_ORG_INFO
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 机构号长度3位=总行(1级)；6位且第4位非9=分行(2级)、第4位为9=大支行(2级)；7位及9/12位=支行(3级)、7位且第5位为9=分理处(3级)；260/270/280特殊机构=总行(1级)

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT DISTINCT org_lvl_cd, CASE org_lvl_cd WHEN '1' THEN '总行' WHEN '2' THEN '分行/大支行' WHEN '3' THEN '支行/分理处' END AS lvl_name FROM VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_01
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 1-总行级(一级), 2-分行/大支行(二级), 3-支行/分理处(三级)

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT org_no, super_org_name, level_one_org_name FROM C_ORG_ORG_INF WHERE org_no LIKE '260%' AND org_no<>'260'
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 所有以260开头的机构（除260本身外），其上级机构和一级机构均归口为'总行'

knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: UPDATE C_ORG_ORG_INF T SET (level_one_org_no, level_one_org_name, level_one_org_abre) = (SELECT P.level_one_org_no, P.level_one_org_name, P.level_one_org_abre FROM C_ORG_ORG_INF P WHERE P.org_no = T.super_org_no) WHERE level_one_org_no IS NULL OR level_one_org_name IS NULL
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: UPDATE C_ORG_ORG_INF T SET (level_one_org_no, level_one_org_name, level_one_org_abre) = (SELECT P.level_one_org_no, P.level_one_org_name, P.level_one_org_abre FROM C_ORG_ORG_INF P WHERE P.org_no = T.super_org_no) WHERE level_one_org_no IS NULL OR level_one_org_name IS NULL
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 机构信息-补全一级行信息，通过上级机构继承
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 目标表C_ORG_ORG_INF自关联，取上级机构(super_org_no)的一级行信息补全当前机构缺失的一级行信息
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 一级行号、一级行名称、一级行简称

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT T.org_no, T.org_name, T.level_one_org_no, P.level_one_org_no AS inherit_level_one_org_no FROM C_ORG_ORG_INF T LEFT JOIN C_ORG_ORG_INF P ON T.super_org_no = P.org_no WHERE T.level_one_org_no IS NULL
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 当机构的一级行信息缺失时，向上级机构(直属上级行)继承其一级行信息，确保所有机构都有完整的一级行归属

keyBusinessRules.ruleName: 信贷机构双源合并规则
keyBusinessRules.condition: CRMS机构 UNION ALL (CRBS机构 WHERE 不在CRMS中)
keyBusinessRules.description: 信贷机构以CRMS(信贷管理系统)为主数据源，CRBS(核心系统)中信贷独有的机构作为补充，通过LEFT JOIN+IS NULL排除已在CRMS存在的机构
机构号前两位为70的是村镇银行机构，信贷机构加工时需排除

keyBusinessRules.condition: start_dt <= 数据日期 AND end_dt > 数据日期; record_sts_cd = '0'(仅CRBS)
keyBusinessRules.description: 基于拉链表(start_dt/end_dt)取当日快照数据，CRBS表额外要求record_sts_cd='0'有效记录

keyBusinessRules.ruleName: 卡机构排除规则（已废弃）
keyBusinessRules.condition: biz_org_no NOT LIKE '%93'（已注释/20251126起移除）
keyBusinessRules.description: 历史上曾排除以93结尾的卡机构，2025年11月26日起不再排除卡机构，机构层级判断也已移除对%93的过滤

keyBusinessRules.condition: LENGTH(org_no)=3→总行(1级); LENGTH(org_no)=6且第4位非9→分行(2级); LENGTH(org_no)=6且第4位为9→大支行(2级); LENGTH(org_no)=7/9/12→支行(3级); 260/270/280→总行(1级)
keyBusinessRules.description: 根据机构号长度及特征位自动推导机构层级
来源系统标注用于crbs_org_flag判断，CRBS来源机构标记crbs_org_flag='1'
本脚本加工的机构类型固定为'2'（信贷机构），与核心机构加工脚本(org_inf_crbs.py)区分

keyBusinessRules.condition: level_one_org_no IS NULL OR level_one_org_name IS NULL → 从上级机构继承
keyBusinessRules.description: 缺失一级行信息时通过上级机构(super_org_no)继承其一级行信息，确保层级树完整性

sourc_sys.CRMS: 信贷管理系统（主数据源）
sourc_sys.CRBS: 核心银行系统（补充数据源）

crbs_org_flag.0: 非核心系统机构（来源于CRMS）

notes: 20240619后仅保留信贷机构加工逻辑，核心机构拆分到dwa_c_org_org_inf_crbs.py脚本
本脚本为切片表更新模式，按ETL_TX_DT重新生成当日数据
CRMS为主要数据源，CRBS仅为信贷独有机构（CRMS不存在的机构）作为补充
20251126起移除卡机构（%93结尾）的排除逻辑，机构层级判断也不再过滤%93
机构层级通过机构号长度规则自动推导，非直接取源表字段
总行营业部(260001)等特殊机构名称通过硬编码UPDATE修正
一级行信息缺失时通过上级机构继承补全，保证层级树完整
